body:
The 4.72.2 update effectively displaced the issue. Now, the new issue: "Cannot find namespace 'google'" in a dozen places in nodes\_modules/instantsearch.js/es/widgets/geo-search/geo-search.d.ts and nodes\_modules/instantsearch.js/es/widgets/geo-search/createHTMLMarker.d.ts.

Also, in nodes\_modules/instantsearch.js/es/widgets/geo-search/geo-search.d.ts, I get the following:

* LIne 121:36 : Property 'google' does not exist on type 'Window & typeof globalThis'
* Line 213:51 : Cannot find name 'google'

EDIT1: Adding "google.maps" to the type section of tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.spec.json solves those issues. However, it creates yet another issue in nodes\_modules/instantsearch.js/es/widgets/geo-search/geo-search.d.ts, Line 213:63
`markerOptions: GeoSearchMarker<typeof google.maps.MarkerOptions | Partial<HTMLMarkerArguments>>;`, Property 'MarkerOptions' does not exist on type 'typeof maps'.
This compilation issue can be solved by removing `typeof` in the file, but it is only a bandaid for developpement that won't work for deployment.
